title: Werkgruppe B
name: Flankierend: glacis hillocks with cupolas; 667 casemates cross their fire over the gaps

notes.form: The four hillocks of concept 8 as glacis mounds: 20 deg to the front, 30 deg to the back, so from the enemy side they read as grass hills.
notes.bunker: Panzerwerk practice: no embrasure faces the enemy. Four Regelbau 667-style casemates sit in the hillock sides facing each other across the two gaps (crossfire on anything entering the yard), embrasures with steel plates behind Flankenmauern, roofs under earth. Five six-loophole cupolas on the tops, a Tobruk, a Leitstand on the rear hillock, the Werkeingang in the yard.
notes.nav: The gaps between the hillocks are the only ways into the yard for tanks: kill zones.
notes.per site: Hillocks can shift per site; identical kit.
